title: Blob Royale protocol v3 set_seat_count command payload
description: How many seats the pre-match lobby should have. The payload names no sender: the server stamps the sending session's controller id, so a controller id is not merely ignored here, it is a closed-schema violation that closes the connection.
$comment: A count, not a delta, so two clients who both choose four agree rather than compounding. A shrink that would remove a filled seat is refused by the tick and changes nothing; a client renders that rule by flooring its control one above the highest filled seat. Added in 2.3.
